quickref.weapon: Shared visual language (status icons, HUD, skins)
quickref.status: BBG 2013-2022 fan frames plus one 2026 playtest frame; Sanchez absent from the Steam trailer and screenshots (2013 footage [Inference, strong])
quickref.look: Slowed = yellow 'Z' (#EEEC39-#FCFF0E) between white curved arrows; Controls Reversed = lime-green '?'; Poisoned = purple/green skull; Caffeinated (Caffeine Injection, not his weapon) = white coffee mug; Invulnerable Field shows no icon. The forearm carries a red lamp (#B30303). Skins seen with weapons: Default, Judge, Gold, Tron-Tastic! (red or cyan lines, probably team colour), Bear of Rhodes.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Hourglass and coffee-mug Special buttons appear in Sanchez HUDs. An unexplained pink-magenta crackle wraps Sanchez in several frames (at 0 and 2 ammo); its cause is unverified.
quickref.impact_end_result: A Z alone cannot identify the weapon: five sources cause Slowed (Fan-wiki). The 2026 playtest shows the Slowed icon from an off-screen magenta beam.

quickref.weapon: Bind Gun (renamed and reworked as Adrenaline Gun, Jun 2021)
quickref.status: Default since BBG 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013). Per the Fan-wiki, renamed Adrenaline Gun and flipped from slowing to speeding targets around Jun 19, 2021. The same cyan model appears in the 2026 playtest loadout thumbnail; the 2026 name and effect are unverified.
quickref.look: Chunky glossy faceted cyan/teal blaster (#468FAB/#3C7089, highlights #6CBCD0, panel lines #1A465F) with a round white muzzle (#E9F0F6, halo #9FC9EF), held across the chest or hip, about 0.35x his height. The card is brighter (#1A9BD5); 2D promo art is darker royal blue (#146399-#2673A8).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Automatic, 0.15 s (wiki, since Dec 2014). A continuous jagged, crackling hot pink-magenta to lilac beam with white flecks (#D38CB4-#F1AAEE) that wavers (Observed 2013-2016). HUD ammo: 50 (2014), 40 (2015-2016, matching the wiki), 50 (2017, probably with equipment), 55 (2022).
quickref.impact_end_result: White-pink starburst with violet lightning tendrils. 2013-2021: the victim is slowed (stacking toward immobile) and shows the yellow-Z icon (Observed). 2021+: the victim is sped up 50% for 0.5 s; no image and no documented icon. Shielded targets get the effect without damage.

quickref.status: Unlock since BBG 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013); 90,000 J then, 60,000 J now (Fan-wiki).
quickref.look: Palm-sized sphere (about 0.2x his height) of black/gunmetal plates (#1D1D26/#413B4E) split by a glowing cross: hot-magenta core (#F423F3) with lilac glow (#C69DD2). The card icon is navy with a violet (#481E89) cross. Held low in the prosthetic hand.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobbed in an arc; sticks to the first surface (Fan-wiki). In flight and stuck on a wall it is a small dark ball with a glowing pink cross (Observed). The wiki contradicts itself on the delay (1 s vs 0 s). HUD 3 (2013, 2018), 5 (2014, probably with equipment).
quickref.impact_end_result: Pale-cyan bubble sphere and/or thin expanding blue rings (#274377/#325585), no fireball; one Dec 2013 frame shows a big yellow-white flash (attribution inferred). Everyone in a large radius is slowed 80% for 2 s and shows the yellow Z. The card shows the victim in blue ripples with a purple crackle outline.

quickref.status: REMOVED. Changelog says 2.9; wiki page created Jun 7, 2014. The 'REMOVED' note was added 2020-11-10; no official removal date. 75 Gas.
quickref.look: Red assault rifle (#9C0001, shadow #620001) with white lightning decals, a silver ribbed top rail (#90908D/#B8B8B8), a tan rear block (#C79B75), held across the chest, about 0.45x his height. The HUD icon is a small red rifle.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Automatic: 0.1 s at launch, now 0.13 s. Ammo 40 at launch, now 30 (Fan-wiki); 2016 HUDs show a 22-round magazine. A thin straight pink-magenta laser with a white core (Observed 2016; that Sanchez fired it is Inference). The wiki says 'red-violetish lasers'.
quickref.impact_end_result: Damage only, no status effect; a zero-damage slight AoE (Fan-wiki). Only a white flare at the target end was seen.

quickref.status: Unlock, level 20; BBG 2.18 (Apr 3, 2015) to present. 300,000 J, cut to 200,000 J in 2.20, now 150,000 J (Fan-wiki). HUD showed 15 rounds through Mar 2018; the wiki now says 20.
quickref.look: Chunky silver-white launcher (#B4B9BF) with a wide black hexagonal muzzle, an icy-blue translucent panel (#C2D6DB/#D5EDED), a mauve-violet rear accent (#9E658B) and a white hooked fin; held at chest height, about 0.45-0.5x his height.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-auto 'in quick succession' (0.2 s, now 0.1 s), 1,200 then 1,400 u/s (Fan-wiki). Flight not clearly seen; a small black white-rimmed ball with pale-cyan streaks at a target's hip may be a shot (Inference).
quickref.impact_end_result: On hit 'they will be opened in a parachute that sticks to the enemy, damaging the enemy and also blocking his/her view' for 1.5 s (Fan-wiki). Observed Apr 2015: a large dark-grey dome (#393C3C, light rim) covering a target's head and upper body (canopy reading is Inference).

quickref.status: Unlock; BBG 2.27 (May 29, 2017) to present; 150 then 60 Gas (Fan-wiki).
quickref.look: Gunmetal three-lobed fidget spinner, a hole in each lobe, dark glossy domed hub (#2F3739/#242C2E); held flat in the prosthetic hand at the waist, about 0.3x his height across.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Explosive projectile, 1 s, 1,300 u/s, 'explodes on contact' (Fan-wiki). HUD 5 (2017), 6 (2022). Flight unobserved.
quickref.impact_end_result: 2017: lime/green star sparkles with curly lime swirls around the target. 2022: a white blocky puff and a lime-green '?' over victims, plus a big lime-green burst next to a dark-green spiral on a wall (Observed). Controls Reversed for 8 s: movement inverted, music muted, sounds echo (Fan-wiki).

quickref.status: Unlock; BBG 2.31 (Mar 8, 2018) to present; 500,000 J then 150,000 J (Fan-wiki). Shown on SkyVu's official 'SkyVuBen rocks New Kelowna Weapon!' stream (Mar 9, 2018). No item description exists.
quickref.look: Dark gunmetal blaster with a glowing violet canister underneath (#3A0DBB, #AE9AF5), a violet-lens scope, a spiky white-lavender crystal shell at the front (#D0CDE7/#F7F5FD) and a white ring muzzle; about 0.45x his height. Render skin: Judge Sanchez.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Small projectile that bursts on any surface; 0.25 s and 20 ammo at launch (HUD 20 observed), now 0.75 s and 10; 800 u/s (Fan-wiki). Flight unobserved.
quickref.impact_end_result: Translucent purple puffs (#8C56AE/#86579B), several shaped like cartoon skulls with white eye holes, drifting in swarms (Observed). Victims are Poisoned (purple/green skull overhead), 8/s for 2 s; the user can poison himself. The wiki's Creepin-taunt Sanchez clone was not seen; the wiki says a kill plays Thriller (do not use).

quickref.status: Default since BBG 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013). The infobox wrongly says 'Primary'.
quickref.look: Card icon: glossy yellow honeycomb sphere (#F4E40D/#D6CB5A). No held prop; renders show empty hands and a lit red forearm lamp.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Orb 'appears from a command gauntlet on his arm'; 'Sanchez hits a button on his arm'; ammo 2, reload 1.5 s, lasts 8 s (Fan-wiki). The Dec 2013 text said it is placed on the ground and 'cannot be used in mid-air'; now it works mid-air. No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Translucent light-yellow dome the size of the Pain Field; anyone inside, enemies included, gets +150 u/s (Dec 2013 text: 'doubled'). The card shows a yellow FAST arch. One 2018 fan frame shows yellow floor glow (attribution Inference).

quickref.status: Unlock since BBG 2.6; 80 Gas (the infobox says 60 and 'Primary', both wiki errors).
quickref.look: Card icon: glossy purple sphere (#7D39C1/#A878CF) wrapped in white circuit bands. No held prop.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Light-purple orb from the arm gauntlet; grounded only; ammo 2, reload 4 s, lasts 15 s (Fan-wiki). No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Translucent light-purple dome; anyone who stays 0.75 s inside is fully cloaked (0% visibility) until the field ends; attacking reveals them until they stop, then they 'quickly fade back' (Fan-wiki). No in-game image found.

quickref.status: Unlock; changelog says 2.9 (page created Jun 7, 2014) at 1,000,000 J; cut to 250,000 J in 2.20; now 150,000 J (Fan-wiki).
quickref.look: No prop; the render shows empty hands and a lit red forearm lamp. The orb is described as 'hazy, light blue' (Fan-wiki).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Orb from the arm gauntlet; grounded only; ammo 2; duration 10 s at launch, now 4 s; reload 7.5 s, now 5 s (Fan-wiki). No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Dome; anyone inside takes 50% less damage, stacking 0.5^n; 'No overhead icon shown'; damage reduction, not true invulnerability (Fan-wiki). No in-game image found.

quickref.status: Unlock, level 10; BBG 2.15 (Dec 20, 2014) to present. Secondary: the Dec 2014 'Primary' label was corrected as a mistake by the same wiki editor on Jan 7, 2015. 275,000/250,000/150,000 J.
quickref.look: Rolled rug, black (#060303) with tan-brown key and knotwork borders (#8A6F52/#604C32). One end is a black cap with two white cartoon eyes and a grey screw-like fuse spike. Carried diagonally, about 0.6x his height.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Launched in an arc (950 u/s at launch, now 600 u/s); stops on any object or player (Fan-wiki). The tumbling roll is observed in flight. HUD 2 rounds (2014-2016); the wiki now says 3.
quickref.impact_end_result: 'the carpet will be opened and fire starts to burst around it'; '3 rapid explosions'; large AoE, self-kill risk (Fan-wiki). Observed: big white/pale-yellow fireball (#FFFFFE/#FEFE8F) with white smoke and an orange ground ring engulfing a Huggable. The unrolled carpet and triple burst were not seen.

quickref.status: Unlock, level 20; BBG 2.16 (Jan 30, 2015) to present; 55 Gas.
quickref.look: Held: orange-brown curved leech or slug (#793A24/#B56F46) with a dark slit marking, in the prosthetic hand, about 0.3x his height. Fan-uploaded concept art shows a red drop-shaped creature with an eye band; only the creature is coloured.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Tossed in an arc, 800 u/s; ammo 1, reload 4.5 s (Fan-wiki; HUD 1/1 observed). Not seen in flight.
quickref.impact_end_result: Where it lands, a giant translucent RED creature projection (#A22F1F) appears, wearing dark-grey sunglasses, with a ring of white triangular fangs around a huge mouth and small black bats with red eyes around it (Observed 2016; matches the wiki's sunglasses and bats, but not its 'dark field'). Drains 25/s from enemies and heals the user, no overheal (Fan-wiki).

quickref.look: Long (about 0.6x his height), gently curved, single-edged silver blade (#BCBCC0) with a dark zigzag temper line, mounted under the red-black prosthetic forearm 'by a metal rod'. Appears only when the melee is equipped.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Melee swing; 110 damage, no stat modifier (Fan-wiki). No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Card diagrams: a slash then a fleeing stick figure; the swoosh is grey on the captioned card and red/pink on the textless card (Observed). In-game hit not seen.

quickref.status: Unlock since BBG 2.6; 120 Gas (the current page's '20 Gas' is probably a typo).
quickref.look: Dark gunmetal gauntlet (#565155) over the prosthetic fist with a round glowing yellow lens (#DBCE25) and three long curved polished silver claws (#E1E1E4/#89898B); about 0.3x his height. The card says 'Similar to Clover Claws'.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Swinging melee; 65 then 70 damage, +10% speed (Fan-wiki). No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Card diagram: three red jagged slash marks outlined in yellow. In-game hit not seen.

quickref.status: Unlock; BBG 2.21 (Jul 3, 2015) to present. Wiki price history: 75 Gas, then 400,000 J (Jul 23, 2015), now 150,000 J; damage 85, now 70.
quickref.look: Dark navy faceted stealth-bomber-shaped blade-gauntlet (#0F0C29/#1B172F) with chevron fins and glowing cyan edge lines, extending a translucent cyan energy blade (#1AFCF9); about 0.35-0.4x his height. Render skin: Judge; in play: Tron-Tastic! (Jul 2015).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Melee; now -10% Health, +20% Movement Speed (Fan-wiki). No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: No mechanic documented for 'strike without even being seen'; hit look not seen.

open_questions: Is the 2026 default primary the Bind Gun (slows) or the Adrenaline Gun (speeds up)? The 2026 loadout thumbnail shows the same cyan model, and a 2026 playtest frame shows a magenta beam with the Slowed 'Z', but the shooter is off screen. Watching the JustNubz showcase's Arbiter chapter (47:23) would settle it.

What does the Adrenaline Gun's speed-up look like on the victim (an icon, a trail)? No image exists and the wiki documents no icon. Do not borrow the coffee-mug 'Caffeinated' icon, which belongs to the Caffeine Injection special.
Cloak Field and Invulnerable Field: no in-game image of either dome or of a cloaked player was found. Their colours rest on the wiki's 'light purple' and 'light blue' text and the card.
Kelowna: the wiki's Creepin-taunt Sanchez clone was never seen in a frame. Does it, and the Thriller-on-kill music, exist in 2026? BBG News must not use Thriller audio or choreography either way.

Drain Field: in a 5twbNI7iakw hq3 frame, a brown open-mouthed creature with red eyes, white fangs and a black-and-white dotted stripe is next to Sanchez. Is it the thrown leech in flight? The HUD shows the Parashoot, so it is unattributed.

Parashoot: the only canopy evidence is one Apr 2015 maxres thumbnail (a large dark-grey dome over a target's head). Its colour in other team or skin contexts, and the projectile in flight, are unconfirmed.
Greased Lightning: when was it officially removed? Why do 2016 HUDs show a 22-round magazine when the wiki gives 40 (2014) and 30 (now)?
Glue Bomb: is the yellow-white flash in the Dec 23, 2013 frame the bomb? The wiki also contradicts itself on the detonation delay (1 s vs 0 s).
Blade Augment: which swoosh colour is current, grey (captioned card Sanchez_weapons.jpg) or red/pink (textless card Arbiter_sanchez.jpg, uploaded two days earlier)? The in-game hit was never seen.
What causes the pink-magenta electric crackle around Sanchez's lower body or hand in several fan frames (at 0/5, 0/15 and also 2/15 ammo)? It is undocumented.

GcPIzMXFYT4 (Jun 6, 2014): the HUD matches Greased Lightning (red rifle with tan top, /40), but the player's body is rendered blue with white electric swirls. Is that a shield-type effect, a skin, or a different class?

Which were SkyVu's 'Two brand new Sanchez weapons' (Jun 6, 2014)? Probably Greased Lightning and Invulnerable Field. web.archive.org stayed blocked ('Blocked by egress policy', then connection failures), and the availability API returns no snapshot for that post, so the 2.6 notes, the Jun 2014 post and the official weapon-card JPG remain unverified today.

The Mar and May 2022 fan HUDs show build '2.53.6', a version absent from the wiki's list (2.53.3 then 3.0 in Nov 2021). Which build were 2022 players on, and does that change the dating of the 55-round Bind/Adrenaline Gun?
Speed Field: the Dec 2013 wiki text says it 'cannot be used in mid-air' and doubles speed; the current text says it works mid-air and adds 150 u/s. Was this a balance change or a correction?
Does the battlebears.com 'Adrenaline Gun' (four staggered projectiles) and 'Speed Field' Super have any bearing on the 2026 BBG re-release, or is it BBH-only? The page names no game.
